sourceBindings.text: Compare a fresh crisp carrot with one that has become limp or rubbery. The contrast illustrates turgor, although it does not alone identify why a field plant wilted. Put a cut celery petiole with leaves into water tinted with safe food coloring, note the starting time, and observe colored paths over several hours or use a sample prepared the day before. The pathways indicate water movement through vascular tissue; the dye is a visible tracer rather than a quantitative nutrient test.
